meta.parties: Fernando Et Al. v. Mathew Et Al

rules.statement: The Court has a discretion to allow the revocation of a proxy granted by co-executors, and this decision should not be interfered with unless it is shown that the discretion was wrongly exercised.
rules.supporting_quote: "I am not prepared to answer that question in the affirmative in this case. All four executors concurred in the joint proxy given to Messrs. Prins and Swan at the commencement of the proceedings."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 27 of the Civil Procedure Code invests the Court with a real discretion as to whether or not the revocation of a proxy should be allowed.
